_comment: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) texts for the German table era_moments. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_TW.

strings.Detail: 180 lines become 270, figures gr: 細節：180行變為270行，人物變大
strings.Detail: every tile gets its own colours: 細節：每塊圖塊都有自己的顏色
strings.Detail: figures breathe, the view moves: 細節：人物會呼吸，視角會移動
由Chimora團隊用四種墨水繪製。
strings.Frames: redrawn as bevelled plates: 邊框：重繪為斜邊金屬板
strings.Most of the people who helped you lied a: 幫過你的人，大多在為什麼幫你這件事上撒了謊。
strings.Palette: light and glow on every colour: 調色盤：每種顏色都有光影與輝光
strings.Quillmarch signed, sealed and sold you t: Quillmarch把你簽了字、蓋了章，賣了兩次。
strings.So did your friends. You kept walking an: 你的朋友們也一樣。你還是繼續往前走了。
strings.Sound: a second voice and an echo join: 聲音：加入第二聲部與回聲
strings.Sound: bell tones in a wide room: 聲音：寬闊空間中的鐘聲音色
strings.Sound: music in layers that follow you: 聲音：隨你而動的多層音樂
strings.Sound: sampled voices and a room: 聲音：取樣人聲與空間混響
小字條款才是誠實的部分。
strings.Up close, everyone had a price and a nic: 湊近了看，每個人都有個價碼和一副好笑容。
strings.You were only cheated by people you like: 騙你的，全是你喜歡的人。
